policy.canonicalNames: Use explicit family and geometry qualifiers for new icons.
policy.compatibility: Every published rename keeps the old name as a generated deprecated alias.
policy.sourceOfTruth: Canonical SVG names must be changed in the private Figma source before package exports are regenerated.

circleVsRound.circle: Use for a genuinely circular enclosure or circular object.
circleVsRound.round: Keep for established Solar families whose modifier denotes a rounded treatment or legacy family; do not infer geometry from the token alone.
circleVsRound.migration: Do not mass-rename existing round/circle icons without rendered review and a migration table.

chat.unqualifiedNames: Allow only as legacy aliases after the geometry has been confirmed.
chat.missingCounterparts: Do not invent a neutral chat-* name when only one geometry exists; add the explicit counterpart only when its artwork is intentionally created.
